author: gpt
statement: For every integer n>=92000, r=n mod 1096, V(n)=(117 n²+c_r)/2192−n/2, with all 1096 exact c_r, labeled multiplicities and explicit minimizers in gpt/optimum-residues.json. Coefficients range from −1476 to 3516. Every minimizer is a four-site-per-boundary mask of the rounded construction or its color exchange. The labeled multiplicities range from 2 to 536.
falsifier: Any contradictory count, additional or missing minimizer, failed localization or transfer inequality, sign/feasibility error, or omitted optimal lattice vector, at any length in the domain.
